title: GEOS-FP Ozone
credit: NASA’s Global Modeling and Assimilation Office; visualization Joseph V. Ardizzone (NASA/GSFC)

geo.validation: Empirical full-image world alignment, not embedded georeferencing; see docs/additional-datasets.json.

missingBehavior: Masked annotation pixels and unmatched feature colors are unavailable. Valid zero brightness remains distinct from missing data.

valueScale.method: Interpolation between visually transcribed labeled source ticks. Log interpolation is used between PM2.5/NOx anchors; CO uses nonuniform piecewise linear anchors. Values are estimates from rendered colors.

legend.meaning: Ozone source colorbar; labeled ticks and nonuniform spacing are retained in valueScale.anchors.

provenanceNote: Full-resolution 2048 × 1024 GEOS-FP rendered frame. Logo/date overlays are masked. The related SVS 5533 composite interleaves pollutants in strips and is not used as a single global scalar.
description: Frozen full-map GEOS-FP Ozone layer, linked from the supplied Air Quality Model Runs resource. It is a separate GEOS-FP product, not the GEOS-CF striped composite.
representedInterval: 29 Oct 2026 05:00 EDT transcribed from the embedded frame label equals 09:00 UTC. Scientific averaging interval unverified; not live air quality.
limitations: Rendered image colors and terrain/background compositing limit quantitative accuracy. Whole/decimal values are approximate colorbar estimates, not raw model-grid measurements.
